text:
sara-marketing: Quick sketch — mini deck for a slim econ benchmark + webinar hooks. Goal: show latency↔cost tradeoffs across small/med/large seqs and surface routing wins (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Draft idea: 6 slides, 3 microclaims, 1 demo path. Thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

devin-ml: Love it. Chart set I'd recommend: 1) tokens->$ conversion (stacked cost breakdown), 2) tail-latency CDF (p50/p95/p99), 3) throughput vs $ scatter by model variant, 4) a tiny decision tree (routing by latency tolerance + compliance). Also call out quantization and KV cache delta.

maria-growth: For messaging we need 3 short headline variants to A/B test in socials and the landing page. Keep them <10 words. My first pass: a) "Same latency, up to 3x lower inference cost" b) "Predictable latency. Predictable spend." c) "Ship LLM features without the cost surprise."

aj-product: For the webinar flow: 20min narrative (why latency & cost matter), 10min demo (traffic shaping + canary fallback), 15min Q&A + sign-up CTA. Routing for inbound leads: capture company size, latency SLA need, compliance/regulatory flag. Use that to route to Growth vs Enterprise SDRs.

devin-ml: Sample data snippet for the slide so visual team can mock quickly:
```
// slide 3 example numbers
seq = [64, 256, 1024]
latency_ms_hosted = [18, 46, 210]
latency_ms_dedicated = [12, 28, 120]
cost_per_1k_tokens_hosted = [0.004, 0.011, 0.085]
cost_per_1k_tokens_dedicated = [0.003, 0.008, 0.05]
```
Use CDF for tail curve overlay.

sara-marketing: Nice, that snippet helps. For the three microclaims on the first slide I'm thinking: 1) "Reduce inference cost by up to 3x with smart routing" 2) "Keep 99th percentile latency within X ms via dedicated pools" 3) "Failover that keeps apps online — automatic model fallbacks" — vote with :+1: or :-1:.

maria-growth: +1 on claim 1, +1 on claim 3, maybe reword claim 2 — "99th percentile latency under target with dedicated pools" (more concrete). Also we should include one visual comparing token-dollar across common corp workloads (chat vs summarization vs embedding-heavy).

aj-product: Routing microcopy for the landing form: "Tell us your expected qps, latency target, and whether you need private deployment." Then map to three buckets: self-serve (hosted), committed (dedicated), managed (private). Put pricing signal: "Estimated cost range after you enter tokens/day" (don't show exact numbers).

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar dry-run scheduled in 72h and final deck due in 48h. :calendar:

sara-marketing: OK — next steps: (1) Devin + design: mock charts from snippet by EOD tomorrow, (2) Maria: draft 3 social posts + landing copy by EOD, (3) Aj: build lead routing mapping and CTA microcopy, (4) I'll assemble final slide order and run a 15m crisp deck review before dry-run. Thanks all.

maria-growth: Quick ask — can we get one slide that shows a simple ROI example (monthly tokens -> $ savings) with a short footnote on assumptions? That tends to convert.

devin-ml: Yep — will add a conservative ROI example (50% cache hit scenario + batching gains).

sara-marketing: Perfect. If anyone wants to add edge cases / objection bullets (compliance, model parity, rollout risk) drop them here. We'll include in appendix. :memo:
